edition_title: Keen Africa Opportunities Digest — July 2026 Edition
edition_intro: You are not waiting for permission — the world's most competitive scholarships, grants, and innovation stages are actively recruiting Nigerians right now. This edition surfaces 13 verified, deadline-confirmed opportunities across scholarships, grants, conferences, competitions, and certifications — curated for builders in Akure and across Nigeria who are ready to move. Read every entry, pick your targets, and apply before the windows close.

posts.title: Chevening Scholarship 2027/2028 — UK Government Fully Funded Master's
posts.summary: The UK Government's flagship global scholarship funds a fully paid one-year Master's degree at any UK university, covering tuition, living costs, return flights, and visa fees — and Nigeria is one of the world's largest recipient countries.
posts.eligibility: Nigerian citizens with a minimum 2:1 undergraduate degree, at least 2 years of post-graduation work experience, and willingness to return to Nigeria for at least 2 years after the scholarship.

posts.title: MEST AI Startup Program (Class of 2027) — Fully Sponsored AI Entrepreneur Fellowship
posts.summary: A fully-sponsored 12-month residential program in Accra — 7 months of intensive AI startup training followed by incubation, with top ventures eligible for up to $100,000 in pre-seed investment.
posts.eligibility: West and East African citizens aged 21–35 with software development experience, basic AI understanding, and entrepreneurial drive; Nigerians eligible with in-person interviews held in Nigeria.

posts.title: Google Africa Applied AI Lab 2026 — Early Access to DeepMind Models + Funding
posts.summary: Google has opened applications for African AI founders and researchers to access early Google DeepMind models, technical mentorship, commercialization support, and potential investment funding — a first-of-its-kind initiative on the continent.
posts.eligibility: African AI startup founders and researchers building technology solutions for African challenges across any sector; open continent-wide.

posts.title: MEST AI Startup Program — Up to $100,000 Pre-Seed Investment (see also: Scholarships)
posts.summary: Beyond the fellowship itself, top ventures from the MEST Class of 2027 receive up to $100,000 in pre-seed investment from the MEST Portfolio at the end of incubation — making this a grant and a scholarship in one package.
posts.eligibility: West and East African citizens aged 21–35 with software development experience and entrepreneurial ambition; Nigerian applicants interviewed in Nigeria.

posts.title: Startup Abuja Innovation Challenge 2026 — ₦100M+ in Cash, AWS Credits & Mentorship
posts.summary: An online national innovation challenge for Nigerian tech startups offering over ₦100 million in total prizes including cash, AWS cloud credits, and structured business mentorship — no equity taken.
posts.deadline: Rolling (check startupabuja.com.ng for current cohort close date)
posts.eligibility: Nigerian startups, SMEs, and entrepreneurs with a working prototype or MVP across EduTech, HealthTech, FinTech, AgroTech, Web3, SaaS, Logistics, Real Estate, or other emerging tech sectors.

posts.title: IFC SME Growth Accelerator Grant — High-Potential African SMEs
posts.summary: The International Finance Corporation's SME Growth Accelerator offers grant support to high-potential small businesses across Africa, targeting companies with strong market traction and a scalable growth plan.
posts.eligibility: High-potential SMEs operating across Africa with a demonstrated market opportunity, sustainable business model, and measurable growth plan; non-dilutive funding.

posts.title: Africa Tech Festival 2026 (AfricaCom & AfricaTech) — Cape Town, 17–19 November
posts.summary: Africa's largest annual tech event — 15,000+ attendees, startup showcases, investor matchmaking, and co-located AI, telecoms, and cybersecurity conferences — with free startup and speaker application tracks.
posts.deadline: Rolling (register interest now; startup and speaker applications reviewed monthly)
posts.eligibility: Open to African tech founders, developers, investors, enterprise professionals, and policymakers; startup showcase applications open to early- and growth-stage companies.

posts.title: Moonshot by TechCabal 2026 — Lagos, October 28–29
posts.summary: Nigeria's premier innovation festival connecting founders, investors, and operators in an energetic two-day event in Lagos focused on Africa's most ambitious tech and business stories.
posts.eligibility: Open to African startup founders, tech professionals, investors, and innovation ecosystem players; Lagos-based and accessible to Nigerians without international travel.

posts.title: DevCareer x Nomba Hackathon 2026 — $6,500 Prize Pool for Nigerian Developers
posts.summary: A fully virtual 5-week payments hackathon open to Nigerian developer teams, with a $6,500 prize pool, engineering mentorship from Nomba, and a direct pathway into the Nomba Developer Partner Program.
posts.eligibility: Developer teams based in Nigeria with backgrounds in software development, product design, or engineering; fully virtual with no travel required.

posts.title: GoGettaz Agripreneur Prize Competition 2026 — Cash Prize for African Agripreneurs
posts.summary: A continental prize competition recognizing and funding young African agripreneurs with innovative, scalable solutions across food and agribusiness — including significant cash awards and global platform exposure.
posts.eligibility: Young African agripreneurs aged 18–35 with innovative solutions addressing challenges in agriculture, food systems, or agribusiness across the continent.

posts.title: AWS AI Practitioner + Cloud Practitioner Dual Certification — 50% Off + Free Exam (Promo Code: AIF2CLOUD)
posts.summary: An active AWS promotion offers 50% off the AWS Certified AI Practitioner exam using promo code AIF2CLOUD, and if you pass, you receive a completely free AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam — two globally recognised certifications for the price of half of one.
posts.eligibility: Open globally to anyone aged 18+, including Nigerians — no technical background required for the AI Practitioner exam; online proctored exams available worldwide.

posts.title: Cisco Networking Academy — Free Self-Paced Courses with Digital Certificates (Always Open)
posts.summary: Cisco's global Networking Academy offers 100+ free, self-paced online courses in cybersecurity, AI, networking, Python, IoT, and data science — each with internationally recognised digital badges and certificates of completion.
posts.eligibility: Open to anyone globally with internet access; no prior IT experience required for foundational courses; Nigerians can enrol directly online at netacad.com.

posts.title: Microsoft Elevate AI Developers Training 2026 — Free Microsoft Certification Programme (Data Science Nigeria x Microsoft)
posts.summary: A fully funded technology training and certification programme organised by Data Science Nigeria in partnership with Microsoft, covering AI, cloud computing, data analytics, and cybersecurity with globally recognised Microsoft certification exams.
posts.deadline: Rolling (check Data Science Nigeria portal for active cohort)
posts.eligibility: Nigerian developers, students, and technology professionals; no prior advanced technical background required for foundational tracks.
